_comment: Open questions the agent should raise when relevant, and answered ones kept so they are not re-asked. The original numbered list in SKILL.md had lost items 2 and 3 to hand-deletion without renumbering, and its top item was already answered 380 lines earlier in the same file.

questions.text: GH and KH on the Hanna checkers, in BOTH tanks, same session.
questions.answer: Measured. Display 161/46 ppm, staging 62/22 ppm. The tanks are NOT matched and staging is the soft one.

questions.text: Tap water GH, KH and TDS - untested, so change-water preparation cannot be specified.
Substrate depth in the display tank, to firm up the ~25 gal estimate.
Guppy sex ratio - if mixed, expect fry and a compounding bioload.
Is the suckermouth an Otocinclus or a juvenile pleco? A common pleco would outgrow the tank.
questions.answer: Confirmed an Otocinclus, not a pleco. It is alone, which is the live concern - the species is shoaling and `aqua species otocinclus` records a shoal minimum this does not meet.

questions.text: Is the Eheim autofeeder in use, and on what schedule?
How long have the staging animals been in quarantine, and what is the plan for moving them out?
questions.answer: Moved to the display tank on 2026-09-12. The staging tank is now empty and still running.

questions.text: Plant species in the staging tank and how established they are - it determines how much grazing surface the nerites and shrimp actually have.
questions.answer: Moot for now - the staging tank holds no animals, so grazing surface there is no longer a constraint. Re-ask if it is restocked.

questions.text: When did the Neocaridina and the two nerites die? All three were in the staging tank, which measured below both the 4 dGH molt floor and the species KH minimum on 2026-09-05. Dates would confirm or rule that out.
Nitrate in the display tank - untested since the stocking rose and the first water change. It is the metric the change was meant to move and the one with no other export path.
The four Neocaridina colour groups now share one tank and will interbreed toward wild brown. Is keeping the lines separate wanted? The staging tank is empty and cycled.
Temperature was not captured with the latest pen reading, though the Kactoily reports it. Worth having alongside pH and ORP.
